# frimpomaasync.com

frimpomaasync.com builds practical business systems for owner-run service businesses. SynKasa handles the front desk. Siesie handles the repeating work behind it. Every build lives in the client's accounts and stays theirs.

Primary slogan: "Watch it work before you pay."

Guarantee: "Live in 7 days, or you don't pay."

The guarantee covers the agreed system going live. It never promises a number of bookings, because bookings depend on the inquiries the business receives.

## Visitor path

1. Name the business leak on the homepage.
2. Take one same-day fix.
3. Watch the relevant working build.
4. Use the SynKasa fit form or Siesie application.
5. Book the confirmed 15-minute call.
6. Receive a recommendation.
7. Review the proposal and agreement.
8. Pay before onboarding begins.
9. Complete onboarding, build, testing, and approval.
10. Launch, train, and hand over.
11. Follow up on performance.
12. Request approved proof, a referral, care, or the next useful system.

The local leak finder, calculator, and Siesie check do not store or transmit visitor inputs.

## SynKasa

Page: https://frimpomaasync.com/synkasa

Fit form: https://frimpomaasync.com/synkasa-fit

SynKasa is the flagship front desk, formerly sold as the Client Catcher. It answers calls, texts, and direct messages in the owner's voice, qualifies the inquiry, books the right time, and follows up.

Current tiers:

- Start: $555 once. Calls, texts, and direct messages are answered, qualified, and booked. Optional care is $99 a month.
- Grow: $1,500 once. Adds follow-up, reminders, review requests, quote chasing, and one dashboard. Optional care is $222 a month. Most owners start here.
- Full: $2,222 once. Adds proposals, deposit collection, and every customer channel the business uses. Optional care is $444 a month.
- Founding Grow: $750 for the first three owners, with a named testimonial required after the front desk has been running.

Care is optional. The front desk stays in the client's accounts if care ends. A later tier can be added to the existing build.

Soma is part of SynKasa. It carries one customer entry into the CRM, calendar, text thread, and working list.

The SynKasa fit form asks for contact details, business type, contact channels, weekly inquiry volume, current booking method, main problem, desired result, and implementation timing. A website or social page is optional.

## Siesie

Page: https://frimpomaasync.com/siesie

Application: https://frimpomaasync.com/siesie-application

Siesie is the back office above the SynKasa ladder. It covers five roles:

1. Scheduling
2. Money
3. Coordination
4. Account management
5. Reporting

Siesie is $25,000 once. It is for an established business where four or five of those roles still return to the owner.

The representative path is: work received, scheduled, coordinated, invoiced, and reported.

The implementation path is: map, build, test, approve, launch, train, and hand over.

The owner supplies the current process, working rules, account access, and timely approvals. Judgment calls, exceptions, approvals, and sensitive conversations stay human.

The Siesie application asks for contact details, business type, team size, monthly job or client volume, current scheduling and invoicing processes, people being coordinated, owner-dependent work, the main bottleneck, implementation timing, and investment readiness. Website, current tools, and additional context are optional.

## Proof

Page: https://frimpomaasync.com/portfolio

The page shows working local videos for SynKasa, Soma, Som, and an operations tracker. Each card states the problem, shows what the build does, and gives one part of the flow a visitor can use.

Client results appear only after the client approves the wording and result. No customer name, testimonial, number, or result is invented.

## Free

Page: https://frimpomaasync.com/free

Free starting points:

- Missed inquiries: the four-message response script and follow-up cadence.
- Unsure what comes first: the Automated Small Business Blueprint.
- Ideas disappear: Som, the free capture app that works offline.
- Need proof: the working SynKasa demo.
- Need a human diagnosis: the 15-minute call.

Som: https://frimpomaasync.com/som

Blueprint: https://frimpomaasync.com/automated-small-business-blueprint.pdf

## Privacy

Policy: https://frimpomaasync.com/privacy

Qualification forms collect only the business context a visitor chooses to submit. Public forms do not ask for passwords, payment details, customer records, private files, or account access.

Form submissions may include business type, inquiry or job volume, current process, desired result, timing, and investment readiness. They are used to review fit and prepare for the call.

Client systems are built in client-owned accounts. The signed agreement names every provider that handles client or customer data.

## Retired routes

The Client Catcher name is retired except for the "formerly" note. `/client-catcher`, `/services`, `/products`, `/solo-business-system`, and `/ai-products` redirect to `/synkasa`. `/soma` redirects to `/synkasa#soma`.
